buildroot.trust_provenance: The official HTTPS release checksum manifest is clear-signed by the jacmet release key, not the newer annotated-tag key. Public-key fixture bytes were obtained from the official buildroot.org/~jacmet/pubkey.gpg source and pinned by SHA256. The tag fingerprint is retained separately as historical provenance, not archive authorization. GPG must authenticate the manifest and bind its unique exact-basename SHA256 to the downloaded archive before extraction. This does not assert Web-of-Trust identity certification.
